title: [Chapitre] IV. Analysis situs (première mouture) : notes manuscrites (10/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. Grothendieck is building an axiomatic 'analysis situs', a tame or stratified topology in the spirit of the 'géométrie modérée' of the Esquisse. The model case (the 'cas type') is a space X with a stratification.

- There is an ordered set 𝔉él of 'elementary figures'. In the model case these are the closed strata-closures, each with its induced stratification, ordered by incidence (inclusion of faces).
- A 'figure' 𝔏 is a subset of 𝔉él satisfying axioms from earlier pages, roughly a locally finite, mutually compatible configuration closed under taking faces.
- Page 11 defines the combinatorial dimension of X ∈ 𝔉él as sup(card C) − 1, where C runs over the finite chains of elements ≤ X. In modern terms this is the height of X in the poset, i.e. the depth of the incidence stratification, not the geometric dimension.
- So dim_comb X = 0 iff X is minimal. In the model case minimal elementary figures are the closed connected (sub)manifolds, i.e. strata without proper faces.
- For a figure 𝔏, dim_comb 𝔏 = sup over X ∈ 𝔏 of dim_comb X.

What page 12 does. It characterises the figures of combinatorial dimension 0 and ≤ 0.
- dim_comb 𝔏 = 0 iff 𝔏 is 'discrete': non-empty and consisting only of minimal elements of 𝔉él.
- Hence these figures are exactly the subsets of 𝔉él_min such that (a) they form a configuration, i.e. their elements are mutually compatible (in practice pairwise disjoint), and the set is non-empty; and (b) they are locally finite.
- In the model case they correspond to the closed parts Y ⊂ X that are non-empty submanifolds. Such a Y need not be connected, and possibly has components of different dimensions. It is stratified by its connected components.
- Conclusion: figures of dim ≤ 0 are identified with closed submanifolds 'in the strict sense', i.e. carrying the trivial stratification.
- The empty submanifold corresponds to the empty configuration (the dimension −1 or −∞ case).

What comes next. The next page starts the theory of subdivision of figures, a refinement of the stratification with the same support.

Purpose. This is basic bookkeeping in an axiomatic, poset-based description of stratified spaces. Here it pins down the bottom layer (dimension 0 = no incidences) of the combinatorial dimension filtration.
errors: No real error. 'Combinatorial dimension' is the poset height (depth of the stratification), not topological dimension, so dimension-0 figures can be manifolds of any dimension. Grothendieck is consistent about this, but the terminology could mislead.

Compatibility of minimal elements is left implicit. It must amount to disjointness, which also guarantees that a locally finite union of disjoint closed connected submanifolds is a closed (possibly non-equidimensional) submanifold. That is fine.

Slight bookkeeping gap: 'discrete' requires 𝔏 ≠ ∅ while 'dim ≤ 0' includes ∅. Grothendieck handles this in the last line by matching the empty submanifold with the empty configuration, so the convention for dim(∅) (−1 or −∞) is implicit.

ideas.what: Combinatorial dimension of an elementary figure / figure as the height of the incidence poset of strata; dimension 0 iff minimal (closed stratum)
ideas.modern_name: height/depth of a stratification; rank function on the face poset of a stratified space (cf. depth in Goresky–MacPherson / Mather stratified spaces)
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard in stratification theory (Whitney, Thom, Mather, Goresky–MacPherson)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5–6 sketches tame topology and stratified 'dévissage' but not this axiomatics

ideas.what: Characterisation of 0-dimensional figures as non-empty locally finite configurations of mutually compatible minimal elementary figures, i.e. closed submanifolds with trivial stratification (strata = connected components)
ideas.modern_name: trivially stratified closed submanifolds; discrete subposets of minimal elements in a face poset

deep.surprise_reason: Routine definitional unpacking in Grothendieck's axiomatic stratified 'analysis situs'. The overall programme (axiomatising tame stratified spaces via posets of elementary figures) is of historical interest, but this page only records the trivial dimension-0 case.
transcription_corrections: Line 3–4: likely 'Ce sont donc les [crossed: configurations] parties de 𝔉él_min qui ont les propriétés suivantes'. The '𝔉él min' (minimal elementary figures) is read as 'Fél min', not 'Fél minimales configurations partielles'. The margin note is probably 'formées de fig. él.'.
a) reads 'c'est une configuration, i.e. [crossed: dis] (mutuellement) compatibles, et elle est non vide'.
'Dans le cas des types' is better read 'Dans les cas types' (cf. 'exemples types' on p. 11).
'd'intersection[?] non-strates[?] par les composantes connexes' should probably read 'd'ailleurs non nécessairement connexes, stratifiées par les composantes connexes'.
's'identifiant[?] les sous-variétés' should read 's'identifient aux sous-variétés (au sens strict, i.e. avec une stratification triviale)'.
